data.name: Triton's Love Boat Sunset Charter
data.headline: Thursday, February 13 | 2.5 Hour Cruise | 4:30-7pm
data.description:
#Triton's Love Boat Sunset Charter 💘 

Hop on board with your Valentine and fill your picnic basket with Little Frenchie’s buffet bites. Then find your picnic set up and get cozy for your sunset cruise! Don’t forget to grab our sweetheart bar special, or your favorite Triton cocktail and enjoy sail-abrating love! 

This Valentine's event takes place at [2700 Shelter Island Dr. San Diego, CA 92106](https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/106097016057293421045)
data.what_is_included:
- 4:30-7pm Charter ❤️⛵️
- Welcome champagne 🥂
- Full buffet by Little Frenchie to fill your picnic basket with 🧺
- Picnic set-up for you and your Valentine 💐
- Fully stocked bar 🍹
- Please arrive by 4pm to check in and sail away by 4:30pm!

Buffet Menu:
- Poached Shrimp with Vadouvan Avocado
- Quiche Bites
- Crudité Cup with French Onion Dip & Seasonal Vegetables
- Jambon Sandwich with Cold Soup
- Puff Pastry with Sliced Roast Beef & Cornichon
- Pâté on Brioche
- Assorted Cookies
- Chocolate-Covered Strawberries
data.cancellation_notes: You must contact us more than 72 hours before your holiday charter to reschedule or to cancel your ticket. If you cancel within 72 hours of your charter or are late/no-show,  you may reschedule without a fee. If you wish to get a refund and cancelled/no-showed within 24 hours of your charter, you will be charged a 20% cancellation fee. You have the option to reschedule to a regular ticketed charter but please note we cannot refund the price difference from the special event when rebooking. Triton Charters may cancel ticketed charters anytime for any reason in which our customers will receive a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
Congrats! You are now confirmed for Triton's Love Boat Picnic! 💝
Reminder: PLEASE BE 30 MINS EARLY. Triton Charters will depart promptly at 4:30pm, so please arrive at 4pm.

- 4:30-7pm Charter ❤️⛵️

Buffet Menu:

- Enjoy custom cocktails, beer, and wine. 

Departure: 2700 Shelter Island Dr. [Click here for map directions!](https://g.page/triton-charters-san-diego?share)

###Parking Directions:
Please click [HERE](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shelter+Island+Dr+%26+Anchorage+Ln,+San+Diego,+CA+92106/@32.7205931,-117.2297802,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deaba20dd194af:0x814f40bb62025a8d!8m2!3d32.7205931!4d-117.2275915) for the map of where to park. For free parking, please park in the rear of the parking lot as there are no meters. We do not have assigned parking, so please be sure to come at least 30 minutes early. 

###Walking Directions:
Once parked, please use this [LINK](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Triton+Charters/@32.7213411,-117.2299103,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x80deab7fd72e5973:0x221232ad56159d50!8m2!3d32.7213366!4d-117.2277216) for walking directions. You must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes before your ticketed charter time. Please fill out your waivers and be prepared to present your waiver via QR code, and have your ID handy before you arrive! 

- The Triton has the largest occupancy of any yacht in San Diego. We are Coast Guard Certified to have up to 105 passengers on board.
- On August 1st, 2020 The Triton arrived from a long 38-day journey and landed in San Diego Bay – Making The Triton the newest yacht in San Diego.
- Splash through San Diego Bay and set your eyes on the greatest monuments that San Diego has to offer.
- The Triton offers cocktails and draft beer on board, served by our amazing bartenders. 
- Your Charter includes a Coast Guard Certified Captain and Crew Members to assist you on your journey. 
- Slide is not available for ticketed charters.
